BiblicalUsage: Chislon is an Israelite, named once as a father. Numbers 34:21 names Elidad the son of Chislon, of the tribe of Benjamin, among the princes appointed to divide the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Chislon is remembered the way most faithful men are: not for what he did, but for the son he raised to stand in the work of dividing God's land.
